# Review Mode Example

## Findings

- [P1] Missing first-contact clarity
  位置：Opening section
  影响：Readers cannot tell what the project is, who should read it, or the safest next step.
  建议：Add a short positioning paragraph and a Quick Start section before implementation details.

- [P2] Hidden collaboration boundary
  位置：Contribution section
  影响：Contributors may make changes without knowing when RFC review is required.
  建议：Add review expectations and RFC escalation criteria near the contribution path.

## Suggested Shape

Start with positioning, then quick start, documentation paths, contribution rules, and maintenance ownership.
